description: Free. Returns the official passport or ID photo requirements for a country (printed size, head height, background, digital file rules, whether editing is allowed, the official source URL and the date we verified it). Call without a country to list the countries covered. No API key needed.

country.description: Country slug, e.g. "us", "uk", "cn", "ca", "fr", "au", "nz", "in", "sg", "jp", "kr", "schengen". Omit to list all supported countries.

name: check_photo_requirements
title: Passport / ID photo requirements
